verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a local video-production app that orchestrates Claude Code or Codex agents. It is not itself a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or endpoint: it only shows that the app uses Claude Code/Codex internally, an extension guide for adding another AI, and a CLI posting command, none of which is an MCP server.
